headline: Record fiscal year, but March-quarter momentum cools
summary_short: Fourth-quarter revenue was $448.5M, up 5.7% y/y but down 22.8% q/q, capping a record fiscal 2026 with full-year revenue of $2.0 billion. Diluted EPS of $1.56 rose 19.1% y/y but fell 41.4% q/q.
summary_long: Fiscal Q4 revenue was $448.5M (+5.7% y/y, -22.8% q/q), capping record full-year revenue of $2.0B (FY26 diluted EPS $7.85 GAAP, $9.26 non-GAAP). Gross margin held near 53.0% (-44bp y/y, flat q/q). Diluted EPS of $1.56 rose 19.1% y/y but fell 41.4% q/q on the sequential revenue pullback, which the release does not explain — management attributes the year's growth to smartphone component demand and higher PC sales. Free cash flow was $149.0M for the quarter (33% FCF margin). Cash rose to $800.9M (+48.4% y/y, +2.9% q/q); shareholders' equity reached $2,128.0M. For Q1 FY27, the company guides revenue of $430-490M and GAAP gross margin of 51-53%.
